description: This file implements GPIO driver functions for the Stellaris microcontroller series, including configuration, interrupt handling, and port operations.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO, handles callback firing and interrupt clearing.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags, setting direction and digital enable.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration flags for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits based on mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits in the port.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO device, calls configuration function.

methods.name: gpio_stellaris_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration for GPIO events.
